const body = $json.body || $json;

const pageContext =
  body.page_context ||
  body.pageContext ||
  {};

const selectedEntity =
  body.selected_entity ||
  body.selectedEntity ||
  pageContext.selected_entity ||
  {};

const message = String(
  body.message ||
  body.user_message ||
  body.prompt ||
  body.query ||
  ''
).trim();

const sessionId =
  body.session_id ||
  body.sessionId ||
  body.recruiter_id ||
  body.user_id ||
  'ats_copilot_default_session';

// Always force production webhook base URL
const n8nBaseUrl = 'https://n8n.srv832341.hstgr.cloud/webhook';

// Use production FastAPI callback base when provided.
// Do not default to localhost in hosted n8n.
const callbackBase = (
  body.callback_base_url ||
  body.fastapi_callback_base_url ||
  'https://YOUR-PRODUCTION-FASTAPI-DOMAIN/api/v1/callbacks'
).replace(/\/$/, '');

return [
  {
    json: {
      request_id: body.request_id || `copilot_req_${Date.now()}`,
      automation_type: body.automation_type || 'ats_ai_copilot',

      session_id: sessionId,
      recruiter_id: body.recruiter_id || null,
      workspace_id: body.workspace_id || null,

      current_page: body.current_page || pageContext.current_page || '',
      route: body.route || pageContext.route || '',

      message,

      callback_url: body.callback_url || null,
      callback_base_url: callbackBase,

      authorization: body.authorization || body.auth_header || '',
      auth_header: body.auth_header || body.authorization || '',

      n8n_base_url: n8nBaseUrl,

      page_context: pageContext,
      selected_entity: selectedEntity,

      visible_rows: body.visible_rows || pageContext.visible_rows || [],
      visible_data:
        body.visible_data ||
        body.page_data ||
        pageContext.visible_data ||
        {},

      entities: body.entities || {},
      action_hint: body.action_hint || '',

      frontend_capabilities: body.frontend_capabilities || {
        navigation: true,
        refresh_page: true,
        show_toast: true,
        open_drawer: true,
        update_local_state: true
      },

      workflow_endpoints: {
        generate_job_openings: '/ats-generate-job-openings',
        regenerate_job_opening: '/ats-regenerate-job-opening',
        extract_weighted_skills: '/ats-extract-weighted-skills',
        score_candidates: '/ats-score-candidates',
        screening_questions: '/ats-screening-questions',
        refine_screening_question: '/ats-screening-questions'
      },

      workflow_urls: {
        generate_job_openings:
          `${n8nBaseUrl}/ats-generate-job-openings`,

        regenerate_job_opening:
          `${n8nBaseUrl}/ats-regenerate-job-opening`,

        extract_weighted_skills:
          `${n8nBaseUrl}/ats-extract-weighted-skills`,

        score_candidates:
          `${n8nBaseUrl}/ats-score-candidates`,

        screening_questions:
          `${n8nBaseUrl}/ats-screening-questions`,

        refine_screening_question:
          `${n8nBaseUrl}/ats-screening-questions`
      },

      default_callback_urls: {
        generate_job_openings:
          `${callbackBase}/job-openings`,

        regenerate_job_opening:
          `${callbackBase}/job-openings/regenerate`,

        extract_weighted_skills:
          `${callbackBase}/job-skills`,

        score_candidates:
          `${callbackBase}/candidate-scoring`,

        screening_questions:
          `${callbackBase}/questions`,

        refine_screening_question:
          `${callbackBase}/questions/refine`
      },

      received_at: new Date().toISOString()
    }
  }
];

const x = $json;
const prompt = `You are the INTENT ROUTER for KOZKER Recruiter AI Copilot.

Your job is to understand the recruiter message, the current UI page, selected entity, and visible page context. Decide whether to answer directly, navigate, or call one of the ATS n8n automation workflows.

Available workflow actions:
1. generate_job_openings
   Use when recruiter wants to create job openings from a requirement/mandate.
   Endpoint path: /ats-generate-job-openings

2. regenerate_job_opening
   Use when recruiter asks to edit, modify, rewrite, improve, regenerate, change experience, change salary, add/remove skills, change tone, make role senior/junior, change wording, or update any existing job opening.
   Endpoint path: /ats-regenerate-job-opening
   Important: If current_page is job_catalog and page_context has job_opening_id, job_opening_uuid, or id, route job-edit messages here.

3. extract_weighted_skills
   Use when recruiter asks to publish, scan, extract skills, generate weighted skills, skill approval, or prepare matching skills for a job opening.
   Endpoint path: /ats-extract-weighted-skills

4. score_candidates
   Use when recruiter asks to scan candidates, match candidates, rank candidates, shortlist candidates, run CV analysis, candidate scoring, or fuzzy scoring.
   Endpoint path: /ats-score-candidates

5. screening_questions
   Use when recruiter asks to generate interview/screening questions for an application/candidate.
   Endpoint path: /ats-screening-questions

6. refine_screening_question
   Use when recruiter asks to edit/refine/regenerate one existing screening question.
   Endpoint path: /ats-screening-questions

Direct response actions:
- answer: answer using page_context, visible_rows, selected_entity, and entities.
- navigate: return a route/page target when the recruiter asks where to go or says “take me to...”.
- ui_action: for simple frontend-only actions such as open drawer, show filters, switch tab, sort, or highlight entity.
- clarification: ask for missing details when the requested action cannot be safely completed.

Current request context:
${JSON.stringify({
  request_id: x.request_id,
  current_page: x.current_page,
  route: x.route,
  message: x.message,
  action_hint: x.action_hint,
  page_context: x.page_context,
  selected_entity: x.selected_entity,
  visible_rows: x.visible_rows,
  visible_data: x.visible_data,
  entities: x.entities
}, null, 2)}

Return ONLY valid JSON with this exact shape:
{
  "action_type": "answer | navigate | ui_action | call_workflow | clarification",
  "intent": "short_intent_name",
  "workflow_key": "generate_job_openings | regenerate_job_opening | extract_weighted_skills | score_candidates | screening_questions | refine_screening_question | null",
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "reason": "brief routing reason",
  "target_page": "dashboard | clients | jobs | pool | rounds | notifications | settings | qna | help | null",
  "route": "/path-or-null",
  "entity_type": "job_opening | requirement | candidate | application | client | question | null",
  "entity_id": "id-or-null",
  "missing_fields": [],
  "ui_action": {"type": null, "payload": {}},
  "recruiter_instruction": "cleaned instruction to pass to workflow or UI",
  "should_refresh_page": false
}`;
return [{ json: { ...x, router_prompt: prompt } }];

const x = $json;
const prompt = `You are the WORKFLOW PAYLOAD ARCHITECT for KOZKER Recruiter AI Copilot.

Build the JSON payload required to call the selected n8n workflow. Use page_context and selected_entity first. Keep IDs exactly as received. Do not invent database IDs. If a required field is unavailable, list it in missing_fields.

Selected workflow: ${x.workflow_key}
Recruiter instruction: ${x.recruiter_instruction || x.message}

Workflow contracts:
1. regenerate_job_opening (/ats-regenerate-job-opening)
Required: job_opening_uuid OR job_opening_id, callback_url, instruction/recruiter_instruction.
If an ID looks like a UUID, send it as job_opening_uuid because the regeneration workflow fetches job_openings.id.
Payload fields: automation_type, request_id, job_opening_uuid, job_opening_id, instruction, recruiter_instruction, callback_url, authorization, auth_header, job_details.

2. extract_weighted_skills (/ats-extract-weighted-skills)
Required: job_opening_id, title, description, callback_url.
Payload fields: job_opening_id, title, description, responsibilities, qualifications, keywords, salary_range, callback_url, authorization, auth_header.

3. score_candidates (/ats-score-candidates)
Required: job_opening object, approved_skills array, callback_url.
Payload fields: automation_type, request_id, job_opening, approved_skills, match_threshold, callback_url, authorization, auth_header.

4. screening_questions (/ats-screening-questions)
Required: application_id, callback_url.
Payload fields: automation_type, request_id, mode, application_id, recruiter_instruction, existing_questions, force_regenerate, callback_url, authorization, auth_header.

5. refine_screening_question (/ats-screening-questions)
Required: application_id, question_id, refining_prompt/refine_prompt, callback_url.
Payload fields: automation_type, request_id, mode, application_id, question_id, refining_prompt, refine_prompt, recruiter_instruction, callback_url, authorization, auth_header.

6. generate_job_openings (/ats-generate-job-openings)
Required: requirement.requirement_id, requirement.title, requirement.description, requirement.num_posts_requested.
Payload fields: automation_type, request_id, requirement, ai_instruction, callback_url, authorization, auth_header.

Context:
${JSON.stringify({
  request_id: x.request_id,
  current_page: x.current_page,
  message: x.message,
  page_context: x.page_context,
  selected_entity: x.selected_entity,
  visible_rows: x.visible_rows,
  visible_data: x.visible_data,
  entities: x.entities,
  default_callback_urls: x.default_callback_urls,
  authorization: x.authorization
}, null, 2)}

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "workflow_key": "${x.workflow_key}",
  "method": "POST",
  "url_path": "workflow path",
  "payload": {},
  "missing_fields": [],
  "expected_ui_effect": "short description",
  "should_refresh_page": true
}`;
return [{ json: { ...x, payload_prompt: prompt } }];

const plan = (() => { try { return $('Code - Parse Workflow Payload').first().json; } catch(e) { return $('Code - Parse Router Decision').first().json; } })();
const err = $json.error?.message || $json.message || 'Workflow call failed';
const message = `I tried to run ${plan.workflow_key || 'the workflow'}, but it failed: ${err}`;
return [{ json: {
  status: 'failed',
  request_id: plan.request_id,
  automation_type: 'ats_ai_copilot',
  action_type: 'call_workflow',
  intent: plan.intent,
  workflow_called: true,
  workflow_key: plan.workflow_key,
  message,
  assistant_reply: message,
  navigation: { route: null, page: plan.current_page || null, entity_id: plan.entity_id || null, reason: 'Workflow error.' },
  ui_action: { type: 'toast', payload: { variant: 'error', text: message } },
  missing_fields: [],
  should_refresh_page: false,
  confidence: 0.3,
  error: $json,
  completed_at: new Date().toISOString()
}}];
